Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my right entered at speed and
struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways into the curb. I did not see the other car
until it was already on top of me, and I had no time to brake or steer away. I have given this same account every time
I have described the collision, to the other driver, to the responding officer, and to my insurer. I am the named driver
on this policy and was operating my own vehicle at the time. Shortly after the crash I felt stiffness and pain in my neck
and upper back, which later was diagnosed as a neck strain. I am still receiving treatment and have been limited in
turning my head and lifting, so I am requesting coverage for the medical costs and the repairs to my vehicle.
